trigger.failure: Runtime Agent BAT/BAT_API registration failed because active service BAT was absent from the physically installed Product Seed

rootCause.details: Canonical OPS_SERVICE, OPS_SERVICE_ENDPOINT and OPS_SERVICE_ROUTING_POLICY masters are marked productionDefault=true but owned by 58_reference_runtime_seed.sql, while every official vendor source plan classifies that file as optionalSampleSeed. generated/current therefore contains BAT/BAT_API but the lifecycle-consumed 00_product_seed.sql does not.

requiredFix: Give runtime Service Registry masters an explicit canonical Product Seed owner, regenerate every official vendor projection and lifecycle bundle, then repeat actual Fresh runtime registration.
prohibitedWorkarounds: Do not weaken central Registry validation
Do not auto-create unauthorized service masters from a Runtime Agent
Do not enable optional/sample seed in the Product runtime smoke
Do not patch generated vendor SQL leaves directly
